title: Escauriaza–Seregin–Šverák and Ladyzhenskaya–Prodi–Serrin regularity
summary: A Lean formalization of two classical regularity theorems for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations. The Escauriaza–Seregin–Šverák theorem states that a Leray–Hopf solution whose spatial L³ norm remains bounded in time is smooth at positive times and unique among Leray–Hopf solutions with the same initial data. The Ladyzhenskaya–Prodi–Serrin theorem gives the corresponding conclusion under a family of mixed space-time integrability conditions.
